# Multi-Agent Patterns {#sec-multi-agent}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Chapter status: skeleton.**
:::

**Learning objectives.** After this chapter you can:

- choose a topology from the shape of the work rather than from fashion;
- recognise the shared-state problems that make multi-agent systems fail;
- state the case for a single agent and know when it wins;
- measure a multi-agent system against a single-agent baseline.

## Exercises

1. Take a task you assumed needed multiple agents. Implement it with one. Compare on score, cost, and latency.
2. Design a shared-state scheme for two agents that can both write. Then describe the race condition you just created.
